system.description:
Also at 2nd level, your expertise with cantrips allows you to make rapid simplified gestures and strike with greater force. You may now use cantrips to make opportunity attacks. For the purpose of the warcaster’s edge, you threaten all spaces within 10ft.

In addition, you gain a pool of exertion equal to twice your proficiency bonus. You recover these exertion at the end of a short rest.

You also learn the Arcane Knight, Duskwood Sniper, Eldritch Blackguard, or Inquisitor’s Brand combat tradition and learn two maneuvers of your choice. The maneuvers you gain from this class can be used with cantrips. Melee maneuvers require melee or weapon cantrips, while ranged maneuvers require ranged cantrips. If a maneuver would allow you to make an attack as a bonus action, you may use a cantrip, but your bonus action cantrip is cast at the lowest level.
